brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivered remarks before a nearly empty United Nations chamber, Zeteo reported, directing criticism at commentators Mehdi Hasan and Cenk Uygur before his speech prompted a walkout. The Israeli leader used the platform to target public figures who have characterized his conduct in Gaza as criminal.

The White House simultaneously released campaign advertisements supporting Donald Trump, according to the outlet, with Zeteo questioning both the sanity and legality of the material distributed during the UN proceedings.
dek: The Israeli PM prompted a walkout then teed up his targets to show him up for the war criminal he is. The White House, meanwhile, pumped out pro-Trump ads of dubious sanity but also likely illegality.
title: Netanyahu attacks critics at sparsely attended UN address
